title: Microsoft rolls back some of its Copilot AI bloat on Windows

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Microsoft just cut the fat from Copilot on Windows — and it’s a win for users.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This update matters now because bloatware is slowing down your PC and draining your battery.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: They’re removing unnecessary features to make Copilot faster and more efficient.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The biggest change? A major reduction in background processes and AI-driven widgets.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This affects Windows 11 users who’ve been frustrated with lag and high resource use.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The takeaway: Microsoft is listening and streamlining AI for real-world performance.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Have you noticed a difference after this update? Let me know in the comments.

caption_text: Microsoft rolls back some of its Copilot AI bloat on Windows
